balanced_small.title: A normal operating week
balanced_small.situation: A small synthetic portfolio has room between commitments. Start by checking that every home can finish on time.
balanced_small.trigger: No disruption is applied in this healthy baseline.
balanced_small.question: Does the schedule leave enough room for routine operational variation?
what_to_watch: On-time commitments and spare crew capacity
The separate install and battery visits
balanced_small.success_criterion: Compare only validated outcomes that respect inventory, skills, territories, readiness, appointments and visit precedence.
balanced_small.truth_label: Synthetic installation portfolio; modeled operational disruptions and costs. Energy values use observed 2018 prices as a hindsight benchmark. No real customer records or observed weather event are used in this story.

tight_feasible.title: Find the last safe margin
tight_feasible.situation: A busy portfolio shares a tightly loaded battery crew. The original commitments are achievable.
tight_feasible.trigger: The busiest battery crew-day is removed in this modeled stress test.
tight_feasible.question: Can the team recover without exceeding its remaining capacity?
what_to_watch: Battery crew utilization before the deadline
Late or deferred work after capacity is removed
tight_feasible.success_criterion: Compare only validated outcomes that respect inventory, skills, territories, readiness, appointments and visit precedence.
tight_feasible.truth_label: Synthetic installation portfolio; modeled operational disruptions and costs. Energy values use observed 2018 prices as a hindsight benchmark. No real customer records or observed weather event are used in this story.

readiness_appointment.title: Respect when homes can host work
readiness_appointment.situation: The healthy schedule assumes each synthetic home is ready and available for its visits.
readiness_appointment.trigger: One home becomes ready later and its battery visit receives an exact appointment window.
readiness_appointment.question: What can still be achieved while honoring both availability constraints?
what_to_watch: Readiness date and the explicit appointment window
No work before readiness or outside the window

two_visit_cascade.title: An install delay reaches the battery visit
two_visit_cascade.situation: Each synthetic home needs an electrical install before its battery appointment, with a two-business-day gap.
two_visit_cascade.trigger: An install appointment moves beyond its original battery date.
two_visit_cascade.question: Which downstream battery commitment must change to preserve precedence?

locked_infeasible.title: A promise that cannot move
locked_infeasible.situation: The healthy plan is fully booked and every appointment is locked.
locked_infeasible.trigger: An install crew-day with locked bookings becomes unavailable.
locked_infeasible.question: Can any option honor the locks, or must the operator revise the assumptions?
what_to_watch: Infeasibility instead of silently moving a lock
Disabled approval when no feasible plan exists
locked_infeasible.success_criterion: Recognize the infeasible promise; do not approve or silently relax a locked visit.

value_sensitive.title: Compare commissioning order
value_sensitive.situation: The healthy plan meets every commitment. A shared capacity stress test exposes choices between otherwise legal recovery schedules.
value_sensitive.trigger: The same busy battery crew-day is removed for both policy comparisons, opening alternative legal commissioning dates.
value_sensitive.question: Does earlier commissioning increase modeled operating margin under identical constraints?
what_to_watch: Assignment differences between objective policies
Historical-price modeled margin, not forecast profit
value_sensitive.success_criterion: Compare only validated outcomes that respect inventory, skills, territories, readiness, appointments and visit precedence.
value_sensitive.truth_label: Synthetic installation portfolio; modeled operational disruptions and costs. Energy values use observed 2018 prices as a hindsight benchmark. No real customer records or observed weather event are used in this story.
